Actual checks:

- Reconstructed all 42 non-muon populations: **8,000 events / 4,889,774 hits**, including truth denominators, native totals and longitudinal sums.
- Reproduced all 38 populations’ **5,000-replica statistics and three 114×114 covariance matrices**. All 3,078 supplemental quantiles match. Closed muon/pedestal attachment is object-identical.
- Deterministic comparison: **22 files / 4,550 events / 1,712,671 accepted cells**, exact cell sets and zero mismatches. Direct strict normalized residual maximum **0.1966895445 < 1**. Independent deep payload/MC checks cover **1,264 events**; all contribution counts/times and closed complete-audit receipts agree.
- Reproduced **all eight stochastic energy/count gate calculations**. Each case has 2,000 distinct original effective seeds and 2,000 distinct native engine seeds; ten distributed payload/endpoint samples per case match.
- Verified **1,177 immutable/artifact hash entries and 59 serialized receipts**.
- Inspected all five original-resolution PNGs and independently reproduced them **byte for byte**. The fifth clearly shows the failed gate and all 22 deterministic rows.

Muon P has SD ratio **1.213693**, CI95 **[0.901417, 1.669784]**, outside the required enclosure. One threshold-adjacent cell produces 9 versus 15 extra accepted pulses; count strata explain **70.6% / 79.8%** of variance. The descriptive core SD ratio is **1.00724**; the configured Poisson expectation is approximately **12.09 crossings per 1,000**. This supports sparse threshold migration as the observed driver, while neither replacing the failed gate nor excluding model differences.

The report accurately preserves this failure and the separate **0.488–0.629 raw nODD/ODD response ratios**, without tiling-only or hardware attribution. Quantile omission, bootstrap-diagnostic wording and cache-recipe findings are resolved. No further consequential figure or report finding remains.

No repository edits, new events, geometry execution, seed changes or gate changes. No human acceptance granted.
